items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 38:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the renewal of souls? The bestowal of the Mochin of the GAR to the souls is discerned as a renewal of souls, because these Mochin were already in them at the time of the greatness of the Nekudim, before the sin of Adam HaRishon; but the Mochin withdrew from them again in Adam HaRishon, having returned and withdrawn from him in the secret of the falling of the limbs of his soul. As is explained in Part 8, at its end, see there. (Item 4).
